purpose: Erection of a stūpa or Buddhist shrine (bhavana) decorated with paintings illustrating the Kinnarī Jātaka, and donation of land to the saṅgha and for the worship of the Buddha
notes: The names of both the female donor (referred to as tayā in line 5 and in the first person in line 6) and the reigning monarch (bhaṭṭāraka-mahārāja-śrī... in line 7) are lost in lacunae. The date mentions the Jovian year Māgha (māghavarṣe kāle) and Āṣāḍha śukla 10, but the numerical year is lost.
